newsitem.title: USA: Bowater says at bottom of market cycle.
newsitem.headline: Bowater says at bottom of market cycle.

text.p: Bowater Inc Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Arnold Nemirow said Monday it appeared that the company, which reported a first quarter loss, was "at the bottom of the current market cycle."

"We look forward to better market conditions in all our product lines throughout 1997...with costs well under control and a strong balance sheet," Nemirow said, "Bowater is in excellent financial condition."
He said the company's inventories are declining, demand for its products is increasing, and product pricing, such as increases for newsprint and coated papers, is improving.
Nemirow also said the company's recent completion of the repurchase of four million shares "reflects our optimism about the future of Bowater."
Bowater produces newsprint, coated and uncoated groundwood papers, bleached kraft pulp and lumber products.
